summary: Full per-episode harvest of the Gintama fandom wiki 'Chapters' infobox field (MediaWiki API) across eps 1-369, cross-matched against Wikipedia's List of Gintama chapters Lesson titles (695/704 titles) and spot-verified via fandom Lesson-page reverse mappings and arc pages. 341 canon/mixed episodes anchored; the adaptation is a heavy reorder regime: season 1 (eps 3-201) shuffles vol 1-34 gag chapters out of publication order, Gintama' opens on post-timeskip L324-326 before rewinding, Gintama° interleaves skipped backlog (L384-465), and Porori-hen (329-341) is entirely backlog (L419-501) slotted between Rakuyou (ends L595) and Silver Soul (starts L596). The stored ep369→704 anchor is wrong: THE SEMI-FINAL adapts L687-698 (ep368: 687-690, 692, 697-698; ep369: 693-696), while L699-704 were published in Jump GIGA and adapted only by the Gintama THE FINAL movie — repair included. Chapter space confirmed as Lesson numbering 1-704 (resolves flag #678; MU's 496 is stale/different edition).

structure.notes: Fandom continuous episode numbering matches OUR cumulative numbering exactly (premiere special = Episode 1-2 counted as eps 1-2; TV run ends ep367; THE SEMI-FINAL = eps 368-369). Season starts confirmed: Gintama'=202 (L324), Enchousen=253 (L372, Kintama arc), Gintama°=266 (L484, Frozen Time arc), Gintama.=317 (L552, Rakuyou — exact v62 boundary), Porori-hen=329 (backlog L419+), Shirogane=342 (L596, Silver Soul), Kouhan-sen=354 (L632), Semi-Final=368. Chapter space = Lesson numbering 1-704 (fandom and Wikipedia titles agree chapter-for-chapter through 704; L1-698 in Weekly Shonen Jump, L699-704 in Jump GIGA); resolves flag #678 — AniList 709 counts extras, MU 496 is stale. Lessons never adapted by the series: 17, 25, 47, 53, 56, 65, 76, 81, 88, 107, 125, 172, 187, 253, 269, 273, 295, 312-313, 423, 435-436, 442, 455, 462, 481, 486-487, 492-496, 498-499, 691, and 699-704 (movie only). Mixed eps 82/111/120 have chapters=N/A on fandom (anime-original with canon slivers) — left unanchored; ep367 (mixed) anchors to L686. DB canon/filler types agree with animefillerlist throughout. Gintama THE FINAL movie (L699-704) is not a DB component; it belongs after ep369 in any order-only chain.
